D.t: Ben Ray Luján leads by 21.4 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 175,006 votes; a one point swing is about 4,093 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +13.2 and D +29.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +16.1. Your best recent poll is SurveyUSA for KOB 4 at D +17.4; your worst is Research & Polling Inc. at D +17.0. 2 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Bernalillo, a projected net 98,326 votes; Santa Fe, a projected net 47,722 votes; Doña Ana, a projected net 20,448 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
